The barrel lacks cylindrical integrity and defined edges. It appears as a soft, extruded shape rather than a machined metal tube. The transition from receiver to barrel is blurred.

The drone hovering above has propellers that look like solid, melted shards rather than thin, distinct blades. They lack the transparency or motion blur expected of a flying drone.
The rim of the front wheel on the blue SUV has an irregular, wobbly circularity that suggests geometric instability in the background objects.
